functions.label: CharEditCommandSeed
functions.role: known analyzed client function used only to anchor the specification

findings.fact: The client registers slot1 through slot8, toggleinven, showinventory, inven_drop, inven_drop_curr, showbarter and hidebarter; the inventory panel formats inven_drop with a selected id or uses inven_drop_curr.
findings.evidence: Hash-pinned client string/function grep joins the command strings to the inventory UI command producers.
findings.consequence: Inventory presentation selects an entry and sends a command; the server owns drop validation and mutation.

findings.fact: The barter/loot client sends vbarter take, buy, give or sell with a slot and retains a target entity index; the hotkey UI stores ten type/data pairs.
findings.evidence: VBarterUI string xrefs expose the four vbarter formats and m_iBarterTgtEntIdx; VHotkeysUI field strings expose m_iHotkeyTypes[10] and m_iHotkeyData[10].
findings.consequence: Loot and vendor panels share a command transport, while transfer authority and prices remain server-side.
